model.name: 50% LASSO + 50% smoothed seasonal nowcast
model.interval: Empirical 80% band from residuals calibrated strictly before each evaluated rolling origin. The published Brazil band uses independent rolling-origin residuals of summed state nowcasts.
model.interpretation: Same-week nowcast after Google Trends is observed; not a forecast of future weeks.

google_trends.normalization: Each UF is a separate three-term request normalized from 0 to 100. Values are not absolute counts and are not comparable across UFs.

srag.infogripe_filter: (TOSSE = 1 or GARGANTA = 1) and (DISPNEIA = 1 or SATURACAO = 1 or DESC_RESP = 1) and (HOSPITAL = 1 or EVOLUCAO in {2, 3})

infogripe.case_definition: (cough or sore throat) and (dyspnea or oxygen saturation below 95% or respiratory distress) and (hospitalization or death)
infogripe.target_compatibility: Same symptom-filtered SRAG target used by the local dashboard model.
infogripe.note: Current-view estimates are revised in place. Use a commit-pinned URL or an archived file for reproducible comparisons.

lasso.note: Point metrics pool all rolling-origin horizons. Coverage is prequential: every interval uses only national residuals whose target week precedes that prediction's origin.

seasonal.note: Point metrics pool all rolling-origin horizons. Coverage is prequential: every interval uses only national residuals whose target week precedes that prediction's origin.
